# ISECure Banking API and SDKs

ISECure provides a hosted banking integration API for Finnish corporate bank connections. It connects software products to banks through the corporate Web Services channel and removes bank-by-bank integration, certificate, and key-management work from product teams.

Canonical pages:
- Finnish: https://www.isecure.fi/
- English: https://www.isecure.fi/en/
- Swedish: https://www.isecure.fi/se/

Primary product:
- REST API for bank file upload, listing, and download.
- OpenAPI documentation for implementation and testing.
- Test API access for developer evaluation.
- TypeScript SDK: https://github.com/dforsber/isecure-ts-client
- Python SDK.
- PHP SDK and wscli command-line tooling.
- Reliable SFTP/S3 synchronization for file-based workflows that do not use direct REST API integration.

Security and operations:
- Hosted separately from the customer software team to reduce exposure and compliance scope.
- PKI certificate enrollment, renewals, import/export, and storage are handled by ISECure.
- Private key storage uses AWS KMS encryption in a PCI DSS level system.
- File materials can require PGP signatures.
- Bank traffic goes through a hardened interface for sensitive financial operations.
- Used by Finnish accounting and ERP software products; bank traffic for hundreds of Finnish companies runs through ISECure.

Supported bank connectivity:
- Nordea.
- OP.
- Danske Bank.
- S-Pankki/LähiTapiola.
- Ålandsbanken.
- Handelsbanken, Aktia, POP Bank, Savings Bank, and OmaSP through Samlink and Crosskey connections.

Important implementation note:
- ISECure does not filter or process bank file types as product-specific materials. Bank files pass through the service; bank agreements, credentials, and certificates are still required.
